question <- how are the word count different between patients doing the gf task <- across different extraction 
extraction  --> select beased on T-task  == grand father and adnf feature.name  ==  "word_count" 
Hypothesis: Then from there split on M- Microphone --> does the microphone change the collection of words (do i have multiple different M values or the same M values )
Same M values ---> cross visit comparison --> 
Different M values same visit --> within visit comparison --> 

Conclusion at the moment of this code missing ness is rlated to the overall CRAMPINGTEX Acronym thus now we need a new doc to evaluate this 


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("duckdb")
library("dplyr")
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra, diffdf, corrplot, broom, purrr, varhandle)
source("replace_chunk.R")
peter_file <- "C:/Users/samake/OneDrive - Oregon Health & Science University/AD and DS Project/csand_data.duckdb/csand_data.duckdb"
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))
nlp_table<-tbl(con, "visits_nlp_tier1_pivoted_unpacked")
```


##select beased on T-task  == grand father and adnf feature.name  ==  "word_count" -> 233 cases --> add groupby --> only built in mics 

```{r}
gf_word <- nlp_table %>% 
  filter(T_Task == "grandfather") %>%
  filter(feature.name == "participant_wc") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(E_Environment)) %>%
  collect %>% 
  group_by(visit_id)  

gf_word %>%  count(M_Microphone)
gf_word %>%  count(visit_id, sort = T)
```

#Cross Visit comparison 
```{r}
gf_word$Enviro_Num <- as.numeric(gf_word$E_Environment)
cor(gf_word$Enviro_Num, gf_word$value, use = "complete.obs" )
```
### cor test

```{r}
cor.test( gf_word$value, gf_word$Enviro_Num)
```


### boxplot 
```{r}
par(pty = "s")
boxplot(gf_word$value ~gf_word$E_Environment)
boxplot(gf_word$value ~gf_word$E_Environment,
        col = c("cyan", "magenta2"),
        main = "word count v enironment",
        xlab = "environment", ylab = "words",
        ylim = c(0, 300))
```

```{r}
word_type <- c( "participant_nouns_freq", "participant_base_verbs_freq", "participant_pasttense_verbs_freq", "participant_gerund_verbs_freq", "participant_pastpart_verbs_freq", "participant_non3rd_verbs_freq", "participant_3rd_verbs_freq", "participant_tos_freq", "participant_adverbs_freq", "participant_adjectives_freq", "participant_modals_freq", "participant_coord_conj_freq", "participant_cardinals_freq", "participant_particles_freq", "participant_personal_pronouns_freq", "participant_wh_adverbs_freq" ,"participant_poss_pronouns_freq", "participant_wh_determiners_freq", "participant_predeterminers_freq", "participant_interjections_freq")
```

4578 rows --> 105 visits
```{r}
gf_word_type <- nlp_table %>% 
  filter(T_Task == "grandfather") %>%
  filter(feature.name  %in% word_type) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(E_Environment)) %>%
  collect %>% 
  group_by(feature.name)  

gf_word %>%  summary()
gf_word %>%  count(visit_id, sort = T)
```

```{r}
ggplot(gf_word_type, aes(x = reorder(feature.name, value), y = value)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}

t.test(value ~ E_Environment, data = gf_word_type)
```
# um rewiden vars 
```{r}
## new variable 
word_reduced <- gf_word_type %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(c(crampingtexs.data, visit_id, value ,E_Environment, feature.name))
```

```{r}
## column for new variable name 
word_reduced <- word_reduced %>%  mutate(new_name =  paste(feature.name, crampingtexs.data, sep ="_" )) %>% 
  arrange(desc(crampingtexs.data))
```

```{r}
## remove crampingtexs
word_reduce <- word_reduced %>% 
  select(-c(crampingtexs.data, feature.name))
```
tis extremely empty
```{r}
### new dataframe 
gf_wide <- word_reduce %>% pivot_wider( id_cols =  c(visit_id,E_Environment ),
                                         names_from = new_name,
                                         values_from = value)
```



# whats the data set look like now 
```{r}
 na_gf <- inspect.na(gf_wide)
#show_plot(na_gf) + coord_flip()

na_gf %>% extract(col=column_name, 
                                        into=c("prefix","feature.name","crampingtexs.data"),
                                        regex="^([^_]+)_(.*)_([^_]+)$",
                  remove=FALSE
                                        ) %>% 
    unpack_crampingtexs(crampingtexs.data) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=fct_reorder(feature.name, ratio_of_NA), x=ratio_of_NA)) + geom_col() + facet_wrap(~crampingtexs.data)

```
